title: Eventual equality of descended quasi-compact opens
statement: Fix the base-changed inverse system, opens, affine charts, finite basic-open presentations, transported sections, witness identities, and selected stage $\lambda_{W_1=W_2}$ constructed in [def-nagata-qc-open-equality-stage]. For every index $\lambda\geq\lambda_{W_1=W_2}$, let $W_{i,\lambda}$ be the pullback of $W_{i,\lambda_0}$ to $Y_\lambda$ (equivalently, the finite union of the transported basic opens on each chart). Then $W_{1,\lambda}=W_{2,\lambda}$ as opens of $Y_\lambda$.

proof.text: The definition node supplies a finite affine cover and, on each chart, power identities witnessing both radical containments. Every element of the finite set $F$ of the definition is $\leq\lambda_{W_1=W_2}=u(F)\leq\lambda$ by [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound], so $\lambda$ is above every element of $F$ and, applying the transition ring maps, every identity transports to the $\lambda$-chart with the pullbacks $f_{ijk,\lambda}$. If a point lies in $D(f_{1jk,\lambda})$, the first identity forces at least one $f_{2\ell k,\lambda}$ to be nonzero at that point, so $D(f_{1jk,\lambda})\subseteq\bigcup_\ell D(f_{2\ell k,\lambda})$; the second identity gives the reverse inclusion after exchanging $1$ and $2$. Taking the finite unions and then the affine charts gives $W_{1,\lambda}\subseteq W_{2,\lambda}$ and $W_{2,\lambda}\subseteq W_{1,\lambda}$, hence equality.

split_report.summary: Expanded the shorthand statement to identify the data and selected stage constructed by def-nagata-qc-open-equality-stage. The proof checks the two transported power identities chartwise, derives the two basic-open inclusions, and glues the finite chartwise equalities. No new nodes were needed; a related Mathlib theorem was recorded as a non-identical generalization.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the proof paragraph asserting that the common upper bound of the finite chartwise power identities imposes both inclusions at every later stage.
